[{"insert":"Low Incline DB Bench Press

This is the last low incline dumbbell bench of the cycle. The slight incline keeps the work on your mid and upper chest while the dumbbells stay easy on your shoulders. Reps drop again this week, so this should be your heaviest dumbbell pressing of the block. Aim to beat Week 4 across all your working sets.
"}]
